lines.en: I tread across the damp grass
My bow sways on my shoulder
I walk the treeline
The quiver clicks at my hip
My mail whispers as I move
I close the distance to bow range
I step around a boulder
My boots sink into the mud
I pick where to plant my feet
I sidle into the shade
I pace along the low wall
I count my arrows as I walk
I press the string to test it
I watch the distance
I straighten my bracer
I count the arrows in my bag
I stand rooted like a tree
I squint and judge the wind
I test the string with my thumb
I roll my shoulder once
I align the fletching
I wait for a target to show
I raise my bow slowly
You stand inside my range
I am measuring the distance to you
I sight you along the string
What hangs at your belt
I lift my chin at you
I heard your steps
I half-draw to test you
One more step and I loose the string.
I nock an arrow
I watch your hands
I am waiting for you to move first
I grit my teeth and stay quiet
That pushed me back a step
My armor took half of it
I nearly dropped my bow
The wound is seeping blood
I steady my breathing
This will not stop me
I need to open the gap
My hands are still shaking
Even archers hate a close blow
I eat after this fight
Set that bread further off
My camp lies behind me
I take no food from an enemy
That roast smell distracts me
I swallow once
My rations are still in my pack
We split it when this is done
My stomach is empty, true
Do not try to buy me with food
Our shoulders knock together
You knocked my bow aside
I keep my feet
My mail takes the brunt
Step back, I need room to draw
That jolt cost me my aim
Dust rises where we clash
You push me back half a step

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的箭在袋里乱响。
lines.en: That jolt sets the arrows rattling in my quiver.
One more shove and I shoot
She carries a bow like mine
We stood watch together one night
She puts an arrow in my hand
She rarely smiles by the fire
I mended her bowstring
Her aim is steadier than mine
We promised to leave together
I kept her old bracer
I count her breathing
Two quivers weigh heavier
I pick up a spent arrow
This one can fly again
I slide it back into the quiver
I pick up a snapped string
I wipe the arrowhead clean
I find an iron nail
This could mend a bow
I weigh it in my palm
I tuck it in my belt pouch
One more arrow to my name
You walked into my range
I saw you move
This arrow has a home now
I draw the string to my ear
You stand in the open

lines.zh: 风从左边来，我偏了半指。
lines.en: The wind comes from the left; I hold off half a finger.
Perfect distance, no more waiting
I hear the string tighten
You crossed my line
My sight rests on your chest
I have practiced this angle
Not one more step
I am taking aim
You are inside my circle
You go left, my string follows
I wait for the wind to drop
Your shadow tells me the range
I count your strides
I am aiming for your leg
You hid behind the trunk
A good arrow beats a tree
I shift my footing
Show your head and I loose
A little closer would be easier
I hold the bow steady
Your breathing lost its rhythm
I wait for my fletching to settle
I want this shot to count
You have to leave cover sometime
My arm is starting to ache
Easy, archers are patient
My arrow has left the string
I loose and it flies
The shaft grazes your shoulder
This one bites the tree
I nock a second at once
Close range will not stop me
The arrow leaps from my cheek
Your hand will not stop it
I shoot at your knee
The second follows the first
The tip tears your sleeve
I step back and shoot again
You can hear the fletching
I send this one in low
The shaft slips your armor gap
I draw the string once more
I always have another
Do not try to reach me
I step out at the treeline
My bow is already strung
The camp whistle called me out
I take my place in the open
Twenty arrows in my quiver
I settle the bow on my shoulder
My boots sink into the mud
I lift my eyes to find you
I have held this ground three days
The wind lifts my cloak
I take shape out of the shade
I cinch my bracer tight
The fire scorches my cloak
I twist my ankle on landing

lines.zh: 水灌进锁子甲，我变沉了
lines.en: My mail fills with water and drags
The blast leaves my ears ringing
Their arrow stands in my shoulder
Magic burns through my bracer
Empty-bellied, I cannot draw full
The strike leaves me half numb

lines.zh: 坠落时我的弓先不见了
lines.en: Falling, my bow vanishes first
